F1.note: 272e2da60d2f makes retired children resume their parent and 4eb3541d2550 explicitly keeps the lost-source failure for sub-agents; neither stops unverified-authority retired yielded runs from being settled as unreachable.

F2.note: None of the listed wake-mutation commits settles the intermediate requester's paused registry run after a rejected nested handoff.

F3.note: restartResumeSkipReason no longer skips createdVia spawn sessions when the interrupted turn is a direct chat turn, so new user turns in retained spawned chats resume.

F4.note: No listed commit makes a retried lifecycle settlement append the classified notice after the requireYielded rejection.

F5.note: The sweep-settle commits change requester-ended detection, logging and crash-interrupted children, not legacy paused rows without waitForMessage or descendants.

F6.note: Queued-input continuation moved out of the per-session try block into a separate loop over orphaned sessions driven by stored pending inputs, so a thrown yield-failure record no longer strands accepted queued messages.

F7.note: resolveRootSubagentRequester now follows createdVia spawn/spawnedBy ancestry from visible dashboard-key children to the true root and marks it (b9377c626147 also lets direct-chat turns in spawned sessions resume).

F8.note: 5724f9518219 removes the stable-batch visible run-failed notice branch, but the yield-batch error terminal on outcome?.delivered !== true remains.
